name: Cozy Autumn by Leno Cainelli
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Cozy Autumn recipe is your go-to option for those warm, earthy fall tones. It brings out the deep oranges, reds, and browns that make autumn so cozy. It softens cooler tones and makes everything feel warm and inviting, perfect for creating the homely mood of the season. This recipe shines in capturing landscapes and nature, as well as in portraits taken in natural light, especially in parks or woods during the fall months.
